caveat: Critical realism plus political agroecology is a heavy theoretical load for eleven hubs; check the conforming/transforming coding is more than a label.
title: Actionable knowledge for agroecological transformation: a critical realist analysis of co-innovation in a transdisciplinary project
why: Asks whether transdisciplinary projects challenge the structural roots of unsustainability or quietly reinforce them, and answers with a conforming/transforming distinction you could turn on your own projects.
